
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MeteorSeed/p/19131402" title="发布于 2025-10-09 16:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# 弃元模式：从语法糖到性能利器的深度解析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>　　在 C# 的语法演进中，“弃元（Discard）” 以一个简单的下划线 _ 成为了既提升代码可读性，又优化性能的 “双料特性”。它并非单纯的语法简化，而是编译器层面对 “有意忽略的值” 的深度优化 —— 通过明确 “忽略” 的意图，不仅让代码更简洁，更能减少内存分配、降低性能开销。本文将从使用场景、核心优势、性能验证到底层实现，全面解析弃元模式的价值。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>什么是弃元模式？</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　弃元是 C# 7.0 引入的语法特性，用下划线 _ 表示 “有意忽略的变量”。它不是一个实际的变量，没有分配值，甚至未分配内存，也无法被访问（尝试使用会触发编译错误 CS0103 The name '_' doesn't exist in the current context）。其核心设计初衷是：通过统一的语法明确 “此值无关紧要”，让编译器和开发者都能清晰理解意图。</span></p>
<p><span>　　简单来说，弃元解决了一个长期存在的问题：如何优雅地处理 “必须接收但无需使用” 的值（如 out 参数、元组多余字段、default 分支等）。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>应用场景</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　弃元的应用场景贯穿代码编写的多个环节，核心是 “用 _ 替代所有无需关注的值或变量”，以下是最典型的场景：</span></p>
<h2><span><span>out 参数：忽略无需使用的输出值</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　许多方法（如 int.TryParse、DateTime.TryParse）通过 out 参数返回额外结果，但有时我们只需要方法的返回值（如 “是否成功”），无需关注 out 输出。此时弃元可替代临时变量，避免冗余。</span></p>
<p><span>　　示例：验证字符串是否为有效整数，忽略解析结果：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> input = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用 out _ 忽略解析出的整数，仅关注“是否成功”</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _)) {
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">输入是有效整数</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>　　传统方式需要声明 int temp; 并忽略，而弃元直接表达 “不需要结果” 的意图。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>元组与对象解构：精准提取所需字段</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　元组或对象的解构常需提取部分字段，弃元可忽略无关项，避免声明无用变量。</span></p>
<h3><span><span>示例 1：元组解构</span></span></h3>
<p><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; 从包含多字段的元组中仅提取 “名称” 和 “价格”，忽略其他：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方法返回 (id, 名称, 价格, 库存)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (_, name, price, _) = GetProductInfo(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1001</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">商品：{name}，价格：{price}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span>示例 2：对象解构</span></span></h3>
<p><span>　　从 User 对象中提取 “用户名”，忽略 “ID” 和 “邮箱”：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> User(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Alice</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alice@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解构时用 _ 忽略 ID 和邮箱</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (_, username, _) =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user; 
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户名：{username}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h2><span><span>switch 表达式：覆盖所有剩余情况</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　在 switch 表达式中，弃元 _ 作为 default 分支，匹配所有未被显式覆盖的情况。</span></p>
<p><span>　　示例：根据订单状态返回描述，用 _ 处理未知状态：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> GetOrderStatusDesc(OrderStatus status) =&gt; status <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    OrderStatus.Paid </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已支付</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    OrderStatus.Shipped </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已发货</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    OrderStatus.Delivered </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已送达</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    _ </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未知状态</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弃元覆盖所有其他情况</span>
};</pre>
</div>
<h2><span><span>忽略方法返回值</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　对于异步任务或有返回值但无需处理的方法，用 _ = 明确表示 “有意忽略结果”，避免编译器警告。</span></p>
<p><span>　　启动后台任务但不等待其完成，用弃元消除警告：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 忽略任务的完成状态和可能的异常</span>
_ = Task.Run(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 耗时操作...</span>
    Thread.Sleep(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>　　如果不将任务分配给弃元，则以下代码会生成编译器警告：</span></p>
<p><span><span>　　// CS4014: Because this call is not awaited, execution of the current method continues before the call is completed.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　// Consider applying the 'await' operator to the result of the call.</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>强制空值检查</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　利用弃元验证参数非空，忽略赋值结果：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Process(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> input) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 若 input 为 null 则抛出异常，否则忽略赋值</span>
    _ = input ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ArgumentNullException(nameof(input));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理 input...</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p><span>　　上面写法等同于：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (input == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ArgumentNullException(nameof(input));
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span>为什么这种写法更好？</span></span></h3>
<p><span>　　简洁性：将原本需要 3-4 行的 if 判断压缩成了一行代码，使代码更紧凑。</span></p>
<p><span>　　可读性（对熟悉语法的开发者而言）：一旦习惯了这种模式，它的意图非常清晰 ——“确保 input 不为 null，否则抛出异常”。它将校验逻辑封装成了一个原子操作。</span></p>
<p><span>　　现代 C# 风格：这是一种越来越被广泛接受和推荐的现代 C# 编码风格，充分利用了 C# 7.0 及以后版本的新特性。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>弃元模式的核心优势</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　弃元的价值不仅在于语法简化，更体现在可读性、安全性和性能的多重提升。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>可读性与维护性：明确 “忽略” 的意图</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　传统处理 “无需使用的值” 的方式（如 int temp; var unused;）存在歧义：读者需判断变量是否真的无用，还是 “暂时未使用但未来可能有用”。弃元用 _ 明确表示 “此值从设计上就无需关注”，强化认知。</span></p>
<p><span>　　例如，以下两段代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 传统方式：歧义</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> temp;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> temp)) { ... }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弃元方式：意图清晰</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> _)) { ... }</pre>
</div>
<p><span>　　后者无需解释 “temp 为何未被使用”，不存在歧义。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>安全性：避免误用未使用的值</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　传统临时变量可能被误引用（如复制粘贴时的疏忽），导致逻辑错误。而弃元是 “不可访问的”，编译器会拦截任何对 _ 的使用，从语法层面杜绝误用。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 错误示例：尝试使用弃元会编译报错</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _)) {
    Console.WriteLine(_); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 编译错误：CS0103</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h2><span><span>性能：减少内存分配与 CPU 开销</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　弃元的核心性能优势源于编译器的针对性优化：对弃元，编译器会跳过内存分配和存储操作，直接减少资源消耗。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>性能验证：弃元模式真的更快吗？</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　为验证弃元的性能优势，我们设计了两个高频场景的对比测试：out 参数处理和元组解构，通过百万级循环放大差异。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>场景 1：out 参数处理（int.TryParse）</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　对比 “用临时变量接收 out 结果” 与 “用弃元忽略” 的耗时：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestOutParameter()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> loopCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10000000</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1000万次循环</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> input = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">12345</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 传统方式：用临时变量接收 out 结果</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> watch1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stopwatch.StartNew();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; loopCount; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> temp;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> temp);
    }
    watch1.Stop();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弃元方式：忽略 out 结果</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> watch2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stopwatch.StartNew();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; loopCount; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.TryParse(input, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _);
    }
    watch2.Stop();

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">传统方式：{watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">弃元方式：{watch2.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">性能提升：{((watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds - watch2.ElapsedMilliseconds) / (double)watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds):P2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202510/270073-20251009163022277-633079906.png" alt="01" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></h2>
<h2><span><span>场景 2：元组解构</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　对比 “声明所有元组成员” 与 “用弃元忽略无关项” 的耗时：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestTupleDeconstruction()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> loopCount =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 10_000_000;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> data = (id: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, name: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, price: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">99.9</span>, stock: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试元组

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 传统方式：声明所有成员（包含无用项）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> watch1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stopwatch.StartNew();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; loopCount; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (id, name, price, stock) = data; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 声明4个变量，仅用name和price</span>
        _ = name +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> price;
    }
    watch1.Stop();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弃元方式：忽略无用成员</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> watch2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stopwatch.StartNew();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; loopCount; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (_, name, price, _) = data; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 仅声明需要的成员</span>
        _ = name +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> price;
    }
    watch2.Stop();

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">传统方式：{watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">弃元方式：{watch2.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">性能提升：{((watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds - watch2.ElapsedMilliseconds) / (double)watch1.ElapsedMilliseconds):P2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202510/270073-20251009163049243-365530304.png" alt="02" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h1><span><span>底层影响：编译器如何优化弃元？</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　弃元的性能优势源于编译器（Roslyn）和 CLR 的深度优化，核心是 “识别 _ 并跳过不必要的操作”。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>内存分配优化：不分配栈空间</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　对于值类型（如 int、struct），传统变量会在栈上分配内存，而弃元 _ 不会被分配任何内存 —— 编译器在生成 IL 代码时会直接忽略对 _ 的存储操作。</span></p>
<p><span>　　例如，int.TryParse(input, out _) 生成的 IL 代码中，不会包含为 out 参数分配栈空间的指令，而传统方式会有加载局部变量地址等指令。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>CPU 指令优化：减少存储操作</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　弃元会跳过值的 “存储” 和 “读取” 步骤。例如，元组解构时，var (_, name, _) = data 生成的 IL 代码仅包含对 name 的存储指令，而传统方式会包含所有成员的存储指令，减少了 CPU 执行的指令数。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>GC 友好：缩短对象生命周期</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　当您用一个局部变量接收一个引用类型，但之后不再使用它时，这个变量会一直持有对该对象的引用，直到方法结束。这会延长对象的生命周期，因为 GC 会认为这个对象 “仍在被使用”。<span>弃元不会保留引用，堆对象可更早被 GC 回收，减少堆内存占用和 GC 压力。</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>完整性检查：编译期错误预防</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　在 switch 表达式中，编译器会检查弃元是否覆盖所有未匹配的情况（如枚举的所有值）。若存在未覆盖的值，会直接报错，避免运行时逻辑漏洞。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>小结</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　弃元模式是 C# 中 “语法简洁性” 与 “性能优化” 结合的典范，其核心价值在于：</span></p>
<p><span>　　- <strong>意图明确</strong>：用 _ 清晰表达 “无需关注的值”，提升代码可读性。</span></p>
<p><span>　　- <strong>安全可靠</strong>：编译器拦截对弃元的误用，避免逻辑错误。</span></p>
<p><span>　　- <strong>性能优异</strong>：减少内存分配和 CPU 指令，高频场景下提升 10%-30% 性能。</span></p>
<p><span>　　- <strong>场景通用</strong>：覆盖 out 参数、元组解构、switch 表达式等多场景。</span></p>
<p><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202509/270073-20250926105511928-738986494.webp" alt="me" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
